input.question: Who won the men's singles U.S. Open 2021?

documents.text: Sep 12, 2021 ... Novak Djokovic hugged Rafael Nadal after the Russian defeated him in straight sets, 6-4, 6-4, 6-4, to win the men's singles title at the 2021 ...
